name: Ezoic Analytics
description: Ezoic Analytics lets publishers explore their website analytics in Claude. Ask questions about pageviews, visits, engagement, ad impressions, video performance, and revenue metrics like EPMV across your Ezoic domains. Break data down by date, country, device, traffic source, and dozens of other dimensions, with filtering and sorting — the same data that powers Ezoic's Big Data Analytics dashboard. The connector is read-only and signs in with your existing Ezoic account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ezoic Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ezoic Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://analytics-mcp.ezoic.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ezoic Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ezoic Analytics provides these MCP tools: get_available_domains, get_impression_data, get_pageview_data, get_rewarded_data, get_shared_video_data, and get_video_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ezoic Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ezoic Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Ezoic Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ezoic Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ezoic Analytics is developed by Ezoic. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
